UI Changes Summary

6 New Enhancements Verified ✅

  1. Smart Sparkline Hiding ✅
    • Constant columns: 🔒 Constant: VALUE
    • Binary columns: Split bar with percentages
    • Low variance: ⚖️ CV: 0.XX (low var)
    • Low cardinality: 🏷️ N categories with pills
  2. Direct Click-to-Sort ✅
    • Full column header now clickable (larger target)
    • Conflicts prevented (buttons, resize handle)
    • Shift+Click still works for multi-sort
  3. Enhanced Binary Visualization ✅
    • Horizontal split bar: F (58%) / M (42%)
    • Color-coded segments (blue/green)
  4. Low Cardinality Display ✅
    • Shows top 3 categories as pills
    • Truncated with tooltips
  5. Drag-Drop Glow Effect ✅
    • BoxShadow: 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4)
    • Better visual feedback during drag
  6. Layout Stability Fix ✅
    • Anchor button: flexShrink: 0
    • Prevents collapse in compact mode

Release Notes Update

Add to v0.4.0 release notes:

## UI Enhancements (Updated)

- **Smart sparkline hiding**: Constant columns show 🔒 badge instead of empty histograms
- **Binary column visualization**: Split bars for yes/no, male/female columns
- **Low cardinality display**: Category pills for columns with < 5 unique values
- **Improved click-to-sort**: Full column header now clickable (larger target)
- **Enhanced drag-drop**: Glow effect during column reordering
- **Layout optimization**: Better stability in compact mode
